title: flowintel contains an authorization bypass in the file-to-note conversion feature for case tasks. (CVE-2026-133840)
description: flowintel versions prior to 4.1.0 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability in the file-to-note conversion feature for case tasks. This flaw allows authenticated users with basic case membership roles (such as editor or queuer) to perform conversion actions on tasks in restricted workflow states (Requested, Rejected, or Request Review) without the required elevated roles. This bypass enables unauthorized reading of attached file contents and creation of notes on restricted tasks, potentially disrupting workflow and circumventing access controls.
